svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A cone cup round the shell with a 12 mm water gap: inside 172

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: across the floor, 253 at the top, 178 tall; outside 180 to 261.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print a plug 12 mm bigger all round than the shell; lay up 4 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor: 25.5 mm centre hole for the spindle; four 6 mm holes on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 60 mm circle, lined up with the shell's.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Closing ring: 4 mm GFRP annulus, 253 outside, 229 inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: four 12 mm spacer bushes stand on the jacket floor over its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes; lower the bowl in, bolt through from below (M6), then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bond the closing ring between the shell and the jacket top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with epoxy. Seal the spindle hole with an O-ring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: fill through the spindle at 10 kPa; no leak at the ring;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: water comes out of every groove hole.
